text: Ad haec dicta homines tacuerunt, nec ei vel unum verbum retulerunt: hoc enim a rege praeceptum fuerat, ne quid ei responderent.
note: proofread: paragraph where the narrative resumes after the Rabshakeh's second speech closes at 18:35 (*… dēfēnsūrus esse videātur?’”*), a sentence start after a question mark; the BSB's break (b m); no KJV ¶ or 1738 indent; without it 18:26–37 runs to 270 words, over 1 Kings' measure of about 250 (as p1's 1:4), now 18:26–35 226 and 18:36–37 44 (the people's silence and the officials' report, leading into 19:1); r7's alternative 18:28 would leave 18:17–27 at 276 (proofreader p3, 2026-11-23)
